title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Developer (remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Product Owner

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. 916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies.   • Strong prompt engineering skills with the ability to direct AI outputs with precision and intention
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently shape AI-generated footage into a coherent, engaging narrative from a brief or concept alone
  • Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or equivalent for post-production and compositing
  • A strong eye for design, visual consistency, and brand aesthetics
  • Sound judgement on music, audio design, and pacing for platform-native content
  • A deep understanding of hooks, retention, and what makes AI content feel intentional rather than generated
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver polished AI-generated content with a human level of creative intention
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project ───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Access to leading AI platforms and tools as part of your workflow ───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required submission form:
  • Optional: Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without examples of work will not be considered.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Técnico SAP I em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Lead Website Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Website Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Website Designer


Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Designer to join our team on enterprise web projects for B2B and SaaS clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency.

You’ll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time.

This role is client-facing: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. We’re looking for someone proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong UX foundation and the experience to hit the ground running in a fast-paced agency environment.

You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.


What You’ll Do

● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality.

● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites.

● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability.

● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution.

● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project.

● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence.

● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each.

● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving.

● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life.

● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality.

● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.


What We’re Looking For

● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities.

● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution.

● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft.

● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow.

● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence.

● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences.

● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles.

● High proficiency in Figma required.; Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus.

● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred.

● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed.

● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.


Why Join BX Studio?

● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands.

● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities.

● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design.

● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.

Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.

  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.

The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

• Building services across the data pipeline

• Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services

• Improving performance and cost efficiency

• Keeping the architecture clean and understandable

• Writing code that is easy to read, test and change

• Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular

• Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows


Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts.


Requirements

You bring:

• 5 plus years of backend engineering experience

• Strong TypeScript experience

• Real experience with AWS serverless services

• Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS

• A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability

• Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process

• Business level English

Conditions

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions


  • Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? 
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? 
  • Can you type both fast and accurately? 
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income? 
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? 
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum Education/Experience Requirements   

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.   

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English. 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.   
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.  


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). description:

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions


  • Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?

  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum Education/Experience Requirements   

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.   

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Sistemas de Comunicação – Comunicação Sem Fio e RF, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos de comunicação da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

A função não se limita à engenharia de operadoras de telecomunicações. Trata-se de uma posição técnica e de suporte a projetos, combinando conhecimento de comunicação, relacionamento com clientes, entendimento de requisitos, seleção de soluções e avanço comercial.

  • Equipamentos de comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF e radiocomunicação
  • Equipamentos de transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Antenas e acessórios RF
  • Módulos, gateways e roteadores industriais
  • Dispositivos IoT
  • Produtos de fibra óptica
  • Switches e dispositivos de rede

  • Instrumentos de teste e ferramentas de instalação

Auxiliar clientes na escolha de produtos com base em aplicação, cobertura, distância de transmissão, estabilidade de sinal, frequência, largura de banda, ambiente, compatibilidade, instalação e manutenção.

Ajudar a SolutionMall a melhorar sua seleção de produtos, comunicação de projetos e estratégia de cooperação no Brasil.

  • Comunicação sem fio ou RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação industrial ou IoT
  • Fibra óptica e redes
  • Data centers ou infraestrutura de rede

  • Integração de sistemas

O candidato deve ter familiaridade com produtos de comunicação e capacidade de compreender requisitos técnicos, seleção de produtos, RFQ, cotações e comunicação com clientes.

Também é desejável compreender cobertura de sinal sem fio, comunicação RF, distância de transmissão, seleção de antenas, conectividade de rede, ambiente de instalação e cenários de aplicação.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, contratantes, compras, fornecedores, distribuidores e stakeholders de projetos.

Proficiência profissional em português. Inglês será considerado uma vantagem.

Preferencial

  • Relacionamento com clientes, contratantes, integradores ou projetos no Brasil

  • Experiência em RFQ, licitações, cotações, comunicação técnico-comercial ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro de comunicação, aprovação de projetos, canais de aquisição e normas locais
  • Experiência com equipamentos sem fio, RF, antenas, micro-ondas, roteadores industriais, gateways IoT, fibra óptica ou instrumentos de teste

5. Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação técnica e suporte a projetos.

As principais atividades incluem:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos

  • Correspondência de soluções de comunicação
  • Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação de produtos e soluções

title: Lead Website Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Website Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Website Designer


Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Designer to join our team on enterprise web projects for B2B and SaaS clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency.

You’ll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time.

This role is client-facing: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. We’re looking for someone proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong UX foundation and the experience to hit the ground running in a fast-paced agency environment.

You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.


What You’ll Do

● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality.

● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites.

● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability.

● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution.

● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project.

● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence.

● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.


The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.


Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.


Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.


You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.


To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.


Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.


We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.


What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact.


Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination 

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.


Media pitching and spokesperson training 

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.


Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. 
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.


About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. 
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. 
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done. 
  • You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. 
  • You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. 
  • You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. 
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. 
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.  


Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. 
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. 


What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Financeiro Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de Financeiro Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time Financeiro e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e receber, incluindo execução de pagamentos;
  • Realização de conciliações bancárias, garantindo a acuracidade das informações;
  • Atualização e controle do fluxo de caixa, assegurando o correto registro das movimentações financeiras;
  • Execução de rotinas financeiras recorrentes com alto volume de transações e prazos definidos;
  • Organização e arquivamento de documentos financeiros e fiscais;
  • Execução e suporte no processo de faturamento e emissão de notas fiscais, incluindo tratamento de inconsistências;
  • Execução de rotinas administrativas e compras corporativas;
  • Gestão e controle de contratos;
  • Execução e suporte ativo no fechamento contábil, com envio de informações e realização de conciliações financeiras;
  • Execução de validações e suporte às auditorias financeiras;
  • Interface com áreas internas e fornecedores para resolução de pendências financeiras;
  • Identificação, análise e resolução de inconsistências financeiras, com proposição de melhorias;
  • Garantir a execução ponta a ponta das rotinas financeiras sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações financeiras.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com rotinas financeiras e administrativas (conciliação, controle e análise de dados);
  • Conhecimento em relatórios financeiros e controles internos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Power BI;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, com boa gestão do tempo e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ERP financeiro (ex: Omie, Conta Azul, SAP, etc.);
  • Experiência construindo dashboards financeiros;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tributos;
  • Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento ou startups;
  • Experiência prévia com processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria;
  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e otimização de processos financeiros.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Automotive Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Automotive Account Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What you’ll do


  • Manage and develop assigned customer accounts and ensure achievement of sales, profitability, and performance targets.
  • Prepare and negotiate quotations for RFQs, costing and pricing, ensuring alignment with agreed margin levels.
  • Identify and win new profitable business within the account.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and support company image.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability and implement appropriate actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with customers to resolve issues efficiently, enhance satisfaction, and drive company targets.
  • Develop sales strategies, plans, and budgets for customer accounts.
  • Track business opportunities, reporting , and account performance.
  • Support team development, define KPIs, and monitor performance.
  • Improve sales and quotation processes and ensure efficient operations.


Your profile


  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in B2B sales management in automotive environment.
  • Understanding of the wire harness products and market is a strong plus.
  • A confident communicator with strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn insights into actions.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professionally resilient and adaptable to the market changes and challenges.
  • Proactive, with a growth mindset and results‑driven approach.
  • A team player who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).


What we offer


  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.
  • Real ownership of accounts and the opportunity to shape customer strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities and the chance to develop leadership skills.
  • Collaboration with global teams and leading industry customers.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits package & company car.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Analista de Negócios Sênior #1005187\" em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do projeto

Procuramos por Business Analyst para participar e entregar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão a refatoração de um conjunto de demandas estruturais. O foco será o atendimento da crescente demanda de revisão de processos de negócio, debatendo a estratégia e priorização das soluções com as equipes de negócio/operações e técnicas em busca do melhor retorno para a empresa e clientes de modo a sempre endereçar escalabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança.

O que você precisa ter

• Ter vivência na gestão de produtos;

• Experiência na gestão de stakeholders;

• Criar, guiar e facilitar o processo de intake, trabalhando em proximidade com as áreas técnicas e de negócio;

• Ajudar as áreas demandantes na definição da visão dos produtos e seus objetivos para os clientes;

• Entendimento e atuação como defensor das necessidades do cliente final;

• Descrever requisitos/stories/épicos de forma a endereçar as necessidades da demanda/iniciativa e facilitar o entendimento das equipes de desenvolvimento;

• Trabalhado com equipes técnicas no refinamento das necessidades apontadas;

• Conhecimento e atuação em modelos de desenvolvimento ágil (ex.: SCRUM, Kanban);

• Atuado na definição e acompanhamento de métricas e objetivos de produtos (KPIs e OKRs);

• Capacidade de comunicação com diversos níveis organizacionais.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

• Gerenciado portfólio de multi-projetos/demandas/iniciativas de diferentes tamanhos e prioridades;

• Capacidade de realizar negociação de escopo em iniciativas multidisciplinares;

• Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;

• Habilidade em escrita técnica;

• Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

• Familiaridade com ambientes financeiros.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de contratação

CLT.


Beneficios para você:

• Vale Refeição;

• Vale Alimentação;

• Assistência Médica;

• Assistência Odontológica;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Gym Pass;

• Auxílio Pet.


Também temos:

• Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian;

• Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos;

• Formação através da Trilha de Liderança.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions


  • Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? 
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? 
  • Can you type both fast and accurately? 
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income? 
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? 
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum Education/Experience Requirements   

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.   

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English. 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.   
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.  


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months.
